pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-edged polygonal geometries with jagged, leaf-like projections. Patches on the posterior flank are significantly smaller and more densely packed than those on the shoulder/lower neck. Edge gradients are sharp with high pixel-level contrast between the dark pigment and light borders.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are distinctly visible as three-way and four-way intersections. Corridor thickness is variable, narrowing toward the rear of the animal and widening at the shoulder region.
